statement: Factory verification: ship /calculator, a JSON weather API route plus /weather page that uses it, and Calculator + Weather links in the top navbar (desktop and mobile).

roadmap_items.title: Verification: calculator page at /calculator
roadmap_items.traces_goal: ship /calculator with basic arithmetic on the public site

definition_of_done: Route GET /calculator renders a client or server page on cpdeol.com layout (Portfolio shell / existing layout).
User can enter numbers and operators (or buttons) and see a correct basic arithmetic result.
Uses design-system tokens / theme classes only (no hardcoded hex); passes pnpm tsc and pnpm lint.

roadmap_items.title: Verification: weather API + /weather page
roadmap_items.traces_goal: JSON weather API route plus /weather page that uses it

definition_of_done: A Next.js Route Handler under app/api (e.g. app/api/weather/route.ts) returns JSON with weather fields from a free no-key HTTP API (e.g. Open-Meteo), or documents minimal mock only if fetch is blocked in dev.
Route GET /weather displays current weather by calling the internal API (fetch relative /api/weather or equivalent) and shows human-readable output.
No secrets in client bundle; passes pnpm tsc and pnpm lint.

roadmap_items.title: Verification: Calculator and Weather in Navbar
roadmap_items.traces_goal: Calculator + Weather links in the top navbar (desktop and mobile)

definition_of_done: Desktop top nav includes links labeled Calculator and Weather to /calculator and /weather.
Mobile nav sheet includes the same two links with the same labels and hrefs.
Uses existing Navbar / config/navigation patterns; passes pnpm tsc and pnpm lint.
